decisions.decision: Permanent unique actor/target praise key governs add-once fact across requests/contexts. Fresh authenticated stock repeat uses a fresh internal operation, returns current canonical count/bit, preserves original praise time and root version on no-op. Receipt for a known internal operation validates exact actor/account/context/server, request fingerprint, ID/start/entropy, retained content/policy and original fact/root version; private terminal outcome is distinct from current observation. Never expose a stale retained count as a fresh current-state observation.

Use existing tx.Runner/TimedRunner and typed receipt resolver. Same known operation never mutates twice. Definite-abort retries retain DecisionAt. UNKNOWN COMMIT reconciles on authoritative writer; missing receipt remains UNKNOWN and cannot re-execute. Found valid receipt proves terminal outcome; return a current coherent praise observation with its own read witness, retaining original command DecisionAt/provenance separately. In normal known-receipt retry, admit actor then validate/read in the single caller transaction. In ambiguous-commit reconciliation, the existing mandatory fresh read transaction supplies the current observation; no extra mutating transaction or parallel replay service. Unresolved command never returns success.
